question: What two points of inquiry must be settled to determine the identity and nature of the soul as it has been declared?
premises: An inquiry is made as to which soul has been declared.
An inquiry is made as to what the nature of that soul is.
The two inquiries are posed as alternatives for clarification.
inference: To understand the declared soul, one must determine both which entity it is and what its nature is.
uncertainties: The prior declaration to which the verse refers is not repeated here.
plain_english: Which soul is it that has been declared? Or what is the nature of the soul?
